title: OpenUV - Global Real-Time UV Index Forecast API

operations.description: Get hourly UV Index Forecast by location and date. Optional altitude, ozone level and datetime could be provided.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] forecast [PARAMS] access alt dt lat lng ozone token x [SCHEMA] forecast result

operations.description: Get daily protection time by location, UV Index from and UV Index to with 10 minutes accuracy. Optional altitide and ozone level could be provided.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] protection [PARAMS] access alt from lat lng ozone to token x [SCHEMA] protection result

operations.description: Get real-time UV Index by location. Optional altitude, ozone level and datetime could be provided.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] uv [PARAMS] access alt dt lat lng ozone token x [SCHEMA] index result uv
